text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup—the day of the decisive 
battle. Dirt powerhouse Hokko Tarumae and 
Wonder Acute will also be competing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she took a detour with media work 
over the summer, Copano Rickey brightly 
takes on the race, believing it was 
nonetheless a necessary experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up against Hokko Tarumae, would she truly 
be able to prove that she had what it 
takes to stand toe-to-toe with the Senior 
Class?
